facts.fact: OBS-CC says a 15 May 2025 agreement between Camtel and Sotel Tchad settled the debt and provided for activating the Nana-Mbere section and the Yagoua-Bongor link to give Chad a second exit.
OBS-CC says Chad has reached the submarine cables through Camtel's fibre in Cameroon since 2015, under a commercial arrangement between Camtel and Sotel Tchad.

OBS-CC says the Central African Backbone programme joined seven CEEAC states including Cameroon with the World Bank, AfDB and EU; the Cameroon component, 916 km of fibre in five priority links, closed with the Cameroon-Central African Republic-Chad phase in March 2016.

systems.owner: CEEAC states with World Bank, AfDB, EU
